player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin Wild Tic Tac Toe. A lokacin da kake juyawa, zaka iya sanya ko dai 'X' ko 'O' a cikin wani fili mara kyau. Kuna cin nasara ta hanyar daidaita alamomi guda uku (X ko O) a jere. Kuna iya cin nasara tare da kowane alama. Zaɓi motsin ku ta amfani da tsari '[X 4]' don sanya X a tsakiya.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Yi amfani da tsarin "[X 4]" ko "[O 2]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Lambar tantanin halitta mara inganci: {cell}. Dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ƙaddamarwa mara inganci. Cell {cell} an riga an shagaltar.

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} sanya alamar su ({mark}) a cikin tantanin halitta {cell}

outcome.win: Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya ci nasara tare da {mark}s!
